d: I just love this artist!! It's completely awesome, and their creations are so hot!! However, I'm creating these folders mainly for personal use, that's why I'm not writing the artist's name directly, so it is harder to find. I don't want to create trouble for them, I've just gotten a lot of their content and I don't want to keep it in my laptop cause... Well, it's so heavy! So, I'm uploading it here, and I'll upload the rest, because I've realized that this is a wonderful file storage, but I don't want to take any profit from it. I'm happy if you see it, like it and find it useful, but my intention is to keep this as private as possible.
